primary_benchmark.name: Europe Brent Spot Price FOB
primary_benchmark.secondary_distribution: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED DCOILBRENTEU
primary_benchmark.fred_independence_note: FRED DCOILBRENTEU is a secondary distribution of EIA data, not an independent second economic source; FRED is used only as a numeric/coverage cross-check.

alignment_definition.chinese_holiday_note: When A-share markets close across a long break, the return is computed from the last A-share anchor price to the next A-share anchor price, automatically absorbing all Brent changes accumulated across the break; the single final holiday-session Brent daily change is not used.
alignment_definition.same_anchor_note: Zero return means no new Brent daily observation between the two A-share points, not an artificial forward-filled return.

source_consistency.conflict_resolution_note: A real source conflict is fail-closed; it is never resolved by choosing whichever source is more favorable to a result.
